answer: A single orchard cup cannot be drunk by two keepers in the same gale. Post 72 units, draw cup C=H(pubkey||grove||watch) mod the orchard board, and when the anemometer first crosses 11.5 m/s sip 0.8 ml nectar from that cup, then fire an 868 MHz signal whose first harmonic lands in that hash's 5 kHz bin. Four grove peers replay the cup scale and analyzer and void any cup or refund on a live watch. A volume miss over 0.15 ml, an off-bin harmonic, or a reused grove-id burns 27 units and idles the key 12 epochs; a cloned spectrum or second fault empties the stake for 18 epochs.
